nphi.with: Expertise France; SCJS Europe; University of Liège; ISEM Institute
nphi.summary: RIVM leads the national biorisk assessment and biorisk-management work packages and co-leads dual-use research oversight in a One Health biosecurity project.

nphi.summary: EDCTP2 regional network of excellence coordinated by Uganda's national health research organisation to strengthen clinical trial and research capacity across Eastern Africa. Tanzania's NIMR and KEMRI were partners alongside European…

nphi.title: TESA II – Trials of Excellence in Southern Africa II
nphi.with: Uganda National Health Research Organisation; Health Research Centre of Angola; Biomedical Research and Training Institute; Blantyre Health Research & Training Trust; Botswana-Harvard AIDS Institute; ECRIN; ISGlobal; AIGHD; UCL; Stellenbosch University; University of Namibia; University Teaching Hospital Zambia

nphi.title: Biosecurity and national dangerous-pathogen inventories in East Africa (incl. lessons learned)
nphi.summary: RIVM coordinated biosafety and biosecurity work, gave four East African countries a pathogen-inventory tool, and is now compiling lessons learned.

nphi.title: BloodTrain Chapter III – Availability, quality and safety of blood and blood products in Africa
nphi.with: South African Health Products Regulatory Authority; Namibia Medicines Regulatory Council; National Drug Authority (Uganda); Food and Drugs Authority Ghana; Tanzania Medicines and Medical Devices Authority; Zambia Medicines Regulatory Authority; Medicines Control Authority of Zimbabwe; AUDA-NEPAD; Africa Society for Blood Transfusion; WHO AFRO; WHO HQ
nphi.summary: Third chapter of PEI's support to African regulators to strengthen and harmonise regulation of blood and blood products.

nphi.title: VaccTrain Next – Regulatory oversight of clinical trials of vaccines and biologicals
nphi.with: Food and Drugs Authority (Ghana); Medicines Control Authority of Zimbabwe; National Drug Authority (Uganda); Pharmacy and Poisons Board (Kenya); Botswana Medicines Regulatory Authority; Rwanda Food and Drugs Authority; Egyptian Drug Authority; AUDA-NEPAD (AVAREF, AU-3S); WHO AFRO; CEPI (Norway)
nphi.summary: Strengthens African regulators' scientific and regulatory capacity to oversee clinical trials of vaccines and biologicals, including for emergency settings.

nphi.title: FOR-GHP – Fellowship in outbreak readiness for global health protection
nphi.actor: Bernhard Nocht Institute for Tropical Medicine (BNITM); Robert Koch Institute (RKI)
nphi.with: Swiss TPH (Switzerland); African Field Epidemiology Network (AFENET), Kampala & Accra
nphi.summary: Blended-learning fellowship training public health multipliers in sub-Saharan Africa in outbreak management, global health security and One Health.

nphi.title: PharmTrain3 – Regulatory capacities for marketing authorisation of medicinal products
nphi.actor: Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM)
nphi.with: AUDA-NEPAD; Egyptian Drug Authority; Food and Drugs Authority (Ghana); Rwanda Food and Drugs Authority; Medicines Control Authority of Zimbabwe; NAFDAC (Nigeria); National Drug Authority (Uganda); Pharmacy and Poisons Board (Kenya); SADC-MRH Secretariat; SAHPRA (South Africa); TMDA (Tanzania); WHO; Paul-Ehrlich-Institut (Germany)
nphi.summary: Train-the-trainer strengthening of African medicines regulators in assessing marketing authorisation applications, focusing on clinical assessment and biologicals/biosimilars.

nphi.title: ARILAC – Advancing Regional Integrated Laboratory Capacity for AMR Control
nphi.actor: Africa CDC with African Society for Laboratory Medicine (ASLM)
nphi.with: European Union (Team Europe Initiative on Sustainable Health Security); Ethiopian Public Health Institute and national AMR reference laboratories
nphi.summary: Four-year EU-supported One Health laboratory initiative launched May 2026 to strengthen integrated laboratory-based AMR surveillance and lab capacity in eight AU member states.

nphi.title: SINCEP-Africa – Institutional networks and capacity for epidemiological preparedness in Africa
nphi.with: Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) Côte d'Ivoire; Ghana Health Service; Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine; PANDORA platform (France); Fundação Manhiça; Ifakara Health Institute; Makerere University; Université de Kinshasa; CNRST-IRSS; Universidad de Navarra; CTI Africa
nphi.type: Network (Global Health EDCTP3 network of excellence)
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 coordination action turning INDEPTH community-based health surveillance sites into trial-ready sites for outbreaks, with Côte d'Ivoire's INSP hosting a new site.

nphi.title: ACT-PREP – Advancing clinical trials and epidemic preparedness research capacity in Africa
nphi.with: Africa CDC; Uganda Ministry of Health; Infectious Diseases Research Collaboration; Somali National University; Université de Kinshasa; MUHAS; Karolinska Institutet; BNITM; UGHE; UCAD; University of Juba
nphi.type: Network (Global Health EDCTP3 network of excellence)
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 network building outbreak clinical-trial capacity embedded in national public health systems, working closely with Africa CDC.

nphi.title: ANTENNA – Training hubs for statisticians and epidemiologists in Eastern, Central and Western Africa
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Saúde Pública (INASA) Guinea-Bissau; Senegal Ministry of Health and Social Action; Hôpital Général de Douala; CRID Cameroon; University of Buea; RARS; UCAD; Joint Clinical Research Centre; Instituto Piaget; Universidade Nova de Lisboa; LSHTM; Universidade de Cabo Verde
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 project creating cross-regional training hubs for epidemiology and biostatistics fellows in Cameroon, Senegal and Guinea-Bissau, with Guinea-Bissau's national public health institute INASA as a beneficiary.

nphi.title: AFRITRAC – African Training Network for Biostatistics, Epidemiology and Infectious Disease Modelling
nphi.with: National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania; Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) Burundi; Africa CDC (partner); Université de Yaoundé I; USTTB Bamako; University of St Andrews; Makerere University; APHRC; University of Cape Coast; CERMEL; Mbarara University; Université Catholique de Bukavu
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 network training 35 early-career professionals through a harmonised master's programme and regional hub, with Tanzania's NIMR, Burundi's INSP and Africa CDC involved.

nphi.title: China CDC Ebola response expert deployments to Uganda and DRC (2026)
nphi.with: Africa CDC; WHO; Uganda Incident Management Support Team; DRC health authorities
nphi.summary: At the invitation of Africa CDC and WHO, China CDC sent successive expert teams in 2026 to support Ebola surveillance, laboratory capacity and infection control in Uganda and the DRC.

nphi.title: MUKET Consortium – AI-enabled early warning for arboviral diseases
nphi.with: Africa CDC; Ethiopian Ministry of Health; national partners in the five MUKET countries
nphi.summary: Five-country consortium led by EPHI, inaugurated in September 2026, linking human, animal, vector, genomic, climate and environmental data with AI/GIS to forecast arboviral disease risk and strengthen laboratory and genomic capacity.

nphi.title: Rospotrebnadzor mobile laboratory support for Ebola response in Uganda and Republic of Congo
nphi.with: Ugandan and Congolese laboratory specialists (no institutes named)
nphi.summary: Under Russia's programme of support to African countries against infections, a Rospotrebnadzor mobile laboratory in Uganda was redeployed to the border with the DRC for Ebola testing, and Congolese specialists were trained and supported…

nphi.title: Building Stronger Public Health Institutions and Systems (BIS), Phase 2
nphi.with: Africa CDC; IANPHI; WHO (multilateral collaborators)
nphi.summary: Norad-funded programme to strengthen public health institutes in four core partner countries, with selected BIS-1 activities continuing in Uganda and Ghana. Themes are climate and health, digital health, infectious diseases, NCDs and…

nphi.title: BRIDGE Network – African-European training network in integrated health informatics and data sciences
nphi.with: Norwegian Institute of Public Health (Folkehelseinstituttet); Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI); Ghent University (coordinator); Uganda Ministry of Health; University of Cape Town; Mountains of the Moon University; IRSP Ouidah; Aga Khan University Kenya; EdenceHealth; Medical Data Management
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 network led scientifically by the Rwanda Biomedical Centre, with Norway's NIPH and Ethiopia's EPHI, setting up five African centres of excellence training researchers to use health data for infectious disease research.

nphi.title: Ebola PREP-TBOX – Toolbox for Sudan ebolavirus outbreak preparedness
nphi.with: Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB) DRC; Uganda National Health Research Organisation; UVRI Clinical Research Program Initiative; Fondation Congolaise pour la Recherche Médicale (scientific lead); Hospital 12 de Octubre research foundation; CNRS; Fabentech
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 project building detection, treatment and public health response tools for Sudan ebolavirus outbreaks, with DRC's INRB and Uganda's national health research organisation/UVRI.

nphi.title: BRIDGE Network – Building Africa's future in health data and infectious disease research
nphi.with: Ghent University (coordinator); Centres of Excellence in Benin, Ethiopia, Uganda, Kenya, Rwanda, South Africa
nphi.summary: EDCTP3-funded network linking African centres of excellence and European partners; NIPH co-leads data harmonisation, data-sharing ethics and communication.

nphi.title: BIS collaboration in Uganda: public health informatics and health systems resilience
nphi.with: Uganda National Institute of Public Health (UNIPH); Makerere University School of Public Health
nphi.summary: Tripartite MoU and collaboration agreement (2023, revised 2025, new 2026) on civil registration and health registry linkage and epidemic-preparedness learning, with PhD scholarships.

nphi.title: Uganda–Korea project to strengthen laboratory systems and infectious disease prevention, detection and response
nphi.with: Uganda Ministry of Health – National Health Laboratory and Diagnostic Services; Uganda National Institute of Public Health; National Public Health Emergency Operations Centre
nphi.summary: USD 8 million project (2022–2026) in Central and Southern Uganda supporting laboratory accreditation, turnaround times, point-of-care testing, digital data systems for mpox and VHF, specimen tracking and training in Korea.

nphi.title: NIH laboratories at the Uganda Virus Research Institute
nphi.with: Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI)
nphi.summary: In October 2022 UVRI and NIH launched new NIH laboratories at UVRI in Entebbe to research zoonotic viruses, extending a UVRI–NIH partnership that dates to 2016.

nphi.title: Africa CDC Eastern Africa Regional Coordination Centre (Nairobi)
nphi.with: Kenya Ministry of Health (host)
nphi.summary: RCC hosted by Kenya's MoH, launched 1 Oct 2021, coordinating Africa CDC activity and outbreak response across Eastern Africa.

nphi.title: HSE–Zambia partnership on specialist training and medical equipment (EQUALS)
nphi.actor: Health Service Executive (HSE) Global Health Programme
nphi.with: Zambian College of Medicine and Surgery; Royal College of Physicians of Ireland (EQUALS Initiative)
nphi.summary: Ireland's HSE helped set up Zambia's postgraduate specialist training (college founded 2017), ships reusable equipment and trains biomedical engineers; the RCPI-backed EQUALS model was later extended to Uganda.

nphi.title: CDC–UNIPH collaboration (FETP, Laboratory Leadership Program, PHEOC)
nphi.with: Uganda National Institute of Public Health (UNIPH); Ministry of Health PHEOC
nphi.summary: CDC supported Uganda's PHEOC (2013), FETP (2015) and launched the Laboratory Leadership Program with UNIPH to strengthen lab management and leadership.

nphi.title: East African Integrated Disease Surveillance Network (EAIDSNet)
nphi.with: National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania (where EAIDSNet started in 2000); EAC Partner State ministries of human and animal health; national health research institutions; Rockefeller Foundation
nphi.summary: One Health cross-border disease surveillance network of EAC Partner States, started as a project at Tanzania's NIMR in 2000 and revitalised at a 2023 meeting in Kigali.

nphi.title: MRC/UVRI and LSHTM Uganda Research Unit
nphi.with: Medical Research Council (MRC); London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine (LSHTM)
nphi.summary: Long-standing UK–Uganda research partnership on HIV and infectious diseases at UVRI in Entebbe, rooted in a 1988 intergovernmental agreement; the unit joined LSHTM in 2018.

nphi.title: Launch of Sierra Leone's Advanced Field Epidemiology Training Program
nphi.actor: National Public Health Agency (NPHA) Sierra Leone
nphi.with: US CDC; African Field Epidemiology Network (AFENET); University of Sierra Leone/COMAHS; University of Ghana; Pandemic Fund via World Bank
nphi.summary: NPHA-led preparation (2025) of the country's first Advanced FETP with US CDC and AFENET technical support and Pandemic Fund financing, including a CDC-aligned curriculum, an MoU and a peer-learning visit to the University of Ghana.

nphi.title: CDC support to Uganda's Sudan virus disease outbreak response (2025)
nphi.with: Uganda Ministry of Health
nphi.summary: CDC worked closely with Uganda's Ministry of Health to support its response to the Sudan virus disease outbreak declared in Kampala in January 2025, and issued travel and clinical guidance in the US.

nphi.title: Uganda laboratory delegation peer visit to South Africa's NHLS
nphi.with: Uganda Ministry of Health Department of National Health Laboratory and Diagnostic Services; African Society for Laboratory Medicine (ASLM LabCoP)
nphi.summary: South–South peer exchange in June 2024 under ASLM's Laboratory Systems Strengthening Community of Practice, in which Uganda's national laboratory department studied how the NHLS is structured and run.

nphi.title: EMPHNET – AFENET inter-regional memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: African Field Epidemiology Network (AFENET)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in June 2024 linking the Eastern Mediterranean and African field epidemiology networks for joint workforce training, preparedness and laboratory collaboration, cross-border deployment of field epidemiologists and knowledge…

nphi.title: EMT TTT – EMT twinning, training and knowledge transfer
nphi.with: MoHSS (Namibia); Ministry of Health (Uganda); Muhammadiyah Disaster Management Center (Indonesia); Johanniter Auslandshilfe; I.S.A.R. Germany; Malteser International; WHO EMT Secretariat; WHO EURO, AFRO, SEARO
nphi.summary: Strengthened national Emergency Medical Teams through twinning and training, with IPC focus in Africa.

nphi.title: NIPH–Uganda collaboration agreement under BIS (health systems resilience, CRVS)
nphi.with: Makerere University School of Public Health; Uganda National Institute of Public Health (UNIPH)
nphi.summary: Collaboration agreement finalised in Kampala in May 2023 covering health system resilience and digital health, including strengthening civil registration and vital statistics, with two PhD students.

nphi.title: UNIPH – ZNPHI peer-to-peer exchange on border health security
nphi.actor: Uganda National Institute of Public Health (UNIPH)
nphi.with: Zambia National Public Health Institute (ZNPHI); IANPHI
nphi.summary: Ugandan NPHI officials visited ZNPHI (reported March 2024; visit likely September 2023) to review points-of-entry surveillance and preparedness at airports and land borders and recommend improvements.

nphi.title: UNIPH peer exchange with Kenya and Rwanda on border health risk mapping
nphi.actor: Uganda National Institute of Public Health (UNIPH)
nphi.summary: In 2022, with IANPHI/US CDC support for border health, UNIPH worked with Kenya and Rwanda on peer-to-peer training and exchange on health risk mapping.

nphi.title: Gates-funded Integrated Disease Surveillance project
nphi.with: INS Mozambique; NIH Pakistan; others not named
nphi.summary: In 2022, IANPHI ran a Gates-funded study of integrated disease surveillance. It made country deep dives in Mozambique, Pakistan, Malawi, Uganda, England, Sweden and Canada, and held a webinar with NIH Pakistan and INS Mozambique.

nphi.title: COVID-19 vaccination campaign for vulnerable groups in Conakry (ANSS with IANPHI)
nphi.actor: Agence Nationale de Sécurité Sanitaire (ANSS) Guinea
nphi.with: US CDC (CIVIE programme, funder); IANPHI; African Field Epidemiology Network (AFENET); Task Force for Global Health
nphi.summary: CDC-funded campaign launched by ANSS in July 2022, with IANPHI support since 2021, targeting people with HIV, TB or NCDs and people over 50 in Conakry; over 500,000 people were vaccinated in the first phase.

nphi.title: ENTRANT – East and Southern African Consortium for Outbreak Epidemiology Training
nphi.actor: London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine
nphi.with: Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI); National Health Laboratory Botswana; University of Nairobi; ZAMBART; Haramaya University; Mwanza Intervention Trials Unit; Ministry of Health and Child Care Zimbabwe
nphi.summary: EDCTP2/Africa CDC-funded consortium offering master's-level outbreak epidemiology training in East and Southern Africa, with UVRI among the African partners.

nphi.title: IDEA Fellowship – Research-based fellowship training in infectious disease epidemiology and biostatistics
nphi.with: Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI); The Open University; Ministry of Health Uganda; Makerere University; UNCST; Mbale Clinical Research Institute
nphi.summary: EDCTP2/Africa CDC consortium that created research-based epidemiology and biostatistics fellowships in Uganda, partnering with UVRI and the UK's Open University.

nphi.title: PANDORA-ID-NET – Pan-African Network for Rapid Research, Response, Relief and Preparedness for Infectious Disease Epidemics
nphi.actor: Fondation Congolaise pour la Recherche Médicale
nphi.with: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC); National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania; Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI); INMI Lazzaro Spallanzani (Italy); University College London; Irrua Specialist Teaching Hospital; University of Zambia; Ifakara Health Institute; CERMEL Lambaréné; KNUST/KCCR; Charité; University of Tübingen
nphi.summary: EDCTP2-funded One Health consortium of African and European institutions preparing for rapid research and response to infectious disease outbreaks; Nigeria's NCDC, Tanzania's NIMR and UVRI were among the African partners and Italy's…

nphi.title: ALERRT – African coaLition for Epidemic Research, Response and Training
nphi.with: Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB); Uganda National Health Research Organisation; Institut Pasteur; Institut Pasteur de Dakar; Institut Pasteur de Côte d'Ivoire; Institut Pasteur de Bangui; Institut Pasteur de Madagascar; Centre Pasteur du Cameroun; Bernhard-Nocht-Institut; ITM Antwerp; KNUST; ALIMA
nphi.summary: EDCTP2-funded network building clinical research capacity to respond rapidly to epidemics in sub-Saharan Africa. Partners include national biomedical/public health institutes (INRB, UNHRO) and the Institut Pasteur network.

nphi.title: Sierra Leone MoH peer learning visits to UNIPH and INS Mozambique
nphi.actor: Uganda National Institute of Public Health (UNIPH)
nphi.with: Sierra Leone Ministry of Health; Instituto Nacional de Saúde (Mozambique); IANPHI
nphi.summary: Sierra Leone Ministry of Health officials visited the Uganda and Mozambique NPHIs (reported March 2017) to capture lessons on establishing and growing a national public health institute.

nphi.title: African NPHI peer learning around Mozambique's INS
nphi.with: IANPHI; US CDC
nphi.summary: Delegations from Malawi and Zambia (2016) and Sierra Leone and Uganda (2017) visited Mozambique's national institute to learn from its set-up.

nphi.title: PHE mentoring of UVRI communications
nphi.with: Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI); IANPHI
nphi.summary: IANPHI-initiated partnership in which PHE assessed and mentored UVRI's public communications (website, social media, media relations, annual reporting) in 2013, part of IANPHI's long-term support to UVRI since 2006.

nphi.title: ACILT laboratory training and the Labs for Life partnership
nphi.actor: National Health Laboratory Service (NHLS) – African Centre for Integrated Laboratory Training (ACILT)
nphi.with: CDC South Africa; PEPFAR; Becton, Dickinson and Company (BD)
nphi.summary: NHLS's African Centre for Integrated Laboratory Training, supported by CDC, provides hands-on training and mentoring to laboratory staff from partner countries, including under the PEPFAR/CDC–BD Labs for Life public-private partnership…

nphi.title: APARET – African Programme for Advanced Research Epidemiology Training (EU FP7)
nphi.actor: Bernhard Nocht Institute for Tropical Medicine
nphi.with: AFENET; Makerere University; University of Ghana; KNUST; Université Joseph Ki-Zerbo; University of Zimbabwe; MUHAS; Ahmadu Bello University; Swiss TPH; WHO; National Foundation for the CDC
nphi.summary: EU-funded programme (2011-2014) supporting FETP graduates in Africa to become independent researchers through mentoring, workshops and small grants.

nphi.title: IANPHI seed and short-term grants to NIMR, UVRI and INSP Côte d'Ivoire
nphi.with: Nigerian Institute of Medical Research; Uganda Virus Research Institute; INSP Côte d'Ivoire; University of Washington
nphi.summary: 2011 IANPHI grants funded research by NIMR (perinatal care) and UVRI (Aedes vector ecology; research-to-policy communication) and HIV/STD research training of INSP Côte d'Ivoire faculty at the University of Washington.

nphi.title: HPA and US CDC partnership on UVRI's 5-year strategic plan
nphi.with: Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI); US CDC
nphi.summary: In 2007, under IANPHI, the UK Health Protection Agency and US CDC worked with UVRI on its 5-year strategic plan and the systems work linked to it.

nphi.title: CDC support to national public health institute development
nphi.with: Ethiopian Public Health Institute; NCDC Nigeria; INS Mozambique; Zambia NPHI; others
nphi.summary: CDC's overview of countries where it helps establish or strengthen national public health institutes (strategic planning, surveillance, laboratory systems, workforce, emergency response).

nphi.title: NIMR technical assistance to UVRI on financial management
nphi.with: Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI)
nphi.summary: Within IANPHI's comprehensive projects, NIMR helped UVRI set up a financial management system and a research support office. About US$16M was leveraged afterwards.

nphi.title: LINDA-FAMILIA – scaling up digital health systems
nphi.with: University College Cork (coordinator)
nphi.summary: EDCTP3 project in which NIPH leads implementation science and trials of digital registries for maternal and child health in four African countries.
